offering_description.value: Mobile banking app and checking account for US consumers living paycheck to paycheck, with small cash advances, budgeting tools and bill alerts. Revenue comes mainly from monthly memberships and fees on instant transfers and cash advances, with banking services provided through a partner bank.

primary_products.value: checking account; cash advances; budgeting tools

primary_services.value: mobile banking; bill and fee management; financial coaching

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual consumers, mainly lower-income workers paid on a regular schedule

revenue_model.value: subscription: monthly membership fee for app features and banking access; transaction or usage fees: fees for instant transfers and expedited cash advances

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: mobile app and banking platform, sold to individual consumers; financial intermediary: offers deposit accounts and cash advances through a partner bank to individual consumers

geography_served.value: US national: consumers across all 50 US states

specialization.value: niche specialist: one consumer banking app line covering checking accounts and cash advances

distribution_channels.value: online: mobile app and website, downloaded through app stores

regulatory_exposure.value: high: consumer banking and cash advances under state money transmitter licenses and CFPB and state consumer finance rules
